segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא: כְּגוֹן שֶׁרָאוּהוּ בַּלַּיְלָה.
segments.en: The Gemara responds that «Rabbi Zeira said:» The mishna is addressing a case «where» the court «saw» the new moon «at night.» Because they saw it at night, their testimony is inadmissible at that time, as testimonies are admissible only during the day. They must therefore wait until the following day and testify as any ordinary person would.

moves.summary: the court saw it at night, so must testify the next day
moves.about: why two must testify though the court saw: they saw it at night, when testimony is inadmissible
